caption: The drawing features a detailed architectural design for a cast iron fireplace back. The central section displays two large, vertically aligned oval panels, each filled with symmetrical, leaf-like, organic ornamental patterns. Flanking these central ovals on either side are narrow vertical panels also decorated with similar leafy motifs. The spaces above and below the main ovals are divided into smaller rectangular gauges, each containing stylized floral decorations, predominantly resembling acanthus leaves. The drawing also includes a side view of the ornate section on the left, showing the profile of the relief pattern. Below the main decorative design, there is a straight-on technical drawing outlining the side elevation and measurements for the fireplace back, with the label "CAST IRON FIRE PLACE BACK." The illustration is rendered in shades of grey and black pencil or ink on beige paper, with precise lines and shading to indicate depth and relief. The composition is centered on the page, with wide empty margins around the artwork and technical information.
title: Fireback
